verdict.rationale: Figma's own docs say it builds high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes and supports precise animations and reusable motion systems. That covers the interactive and animation parts of the story. The evidence never mentions conditional logic or variables used inside prototypes; the variables evidence covers design tokens and APIs only. Scroll effects and state-to-state transitions are also undocumented. missing for 10: documented animation between states (e.g. smart-animate transitions), prototype conditions/variables logic, scroll effects, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, prototypes can carry advanced behavior — animation between states, conditions or variables, scroll effects — to feel like the real product

citations.quote: Figma's prototyping tools make it easy to build and share high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes.
Create precise animations, build out reusable motion systems, and ship dev-ready animations.
